nodes.title: by having VRR activated in gnome, electron applications with version 39-40 are limited to 60fps
nodes.body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Electron Version

39.8.9-1 and 40.9.3-1

### What operating system(s) are you using?

Other Linux

### Operating System Version

Archlinux, Gnome 50.1

### What arch are you using?

x64

### Last Known Working Electron version

_No response_

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

no

### Expected Behavior

I hope that these applications match the Hz of the monitor in question and that it is not necessary to disable VRR to do so or force the application to run at x11


### Actual Behavior

What the title says happens, if the app is made with an electronic version less than 41, if you have vrr active, these apps will go at 60fps, looking horrible in high frame rate monitor (in my case 165hz)

this problem occurs in applications such as vscode, obsidian, drawio, vesktop, that is, those applications built with the aforementioned electron versions

### Testcase Gist URL

_No response_

### Additional Information

Solution for now : disable VRR or forze app to run in x11 whit flag --ozone-platform=x11
this does not occur in electron 41 versions

nodes.title: Custom protocol via protocol.handle() not compatible with Chromium media playback
nodes.body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Electron Version

41.1.1

### What operating system(s) are you using?

macOS

### Operating System Version

15.7.4

### What arch are you using?

x64

### Last Known Working Electron version

_No response_

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

I don't know how to test

### Expected Behavior

A `<video>` element should be able to play a local MP4 file when served via `protocol.handle()` using a custom scheme, provided that:

- The response includes a valid `Content-Type` (e.g., `video/mp4`)
- Proper range request handling is implemented (`206 Partial Content`, `Content-Range`, `Accept-Ranges`, etc.)
- The response body contains the correct byte ranges from the file

This should behave equivalently to other Electron-supported methods of serving local media, including:

- `file://` URLs  
- HTTP (`http://127.0.0.1`)  

`protocol.handle()` should support media playback use cases in parity with other mechanisms for local file access.

### Actual Behavior

In the attached repro, the videos play correctly via `file://`, HTTP, and blob URL methods, but fail when served through `protocol.handle()` with a manually constructed `Response` (Buffer or stream), even when headers and range handling appear correct. Video1 plays with a `net.fetch`, but video2 fails. Both fail with buffer and stream inside `handle()`. Both also fail with the deprecated `registerFileProtocol`.

### Testcase Gist URL

https://gist.github.com/JamesHabben/c8790e32af88279fe8dfc7a67bb32f49

### Additional Information

Could be related to https://github.com/electron/electron/issues/38749

nodes.title: Use the same linter rules on main and all stable branches
nodes.body:
The [oxfmt PR](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/50692) was never backported.

This requires many backports to be edited manually to have the old code style.
